title: finding(components,html-tier): a `kind:'html'` page's `code` tag renders the `field:code` widget and drops the authored text — the html tier registers no `code` element
body: Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, measured by the dev and read by the seat at source (class a). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10735 dev report (PR objectui#10753, comment `5852849962`, open question 1). The seat ruled there that `code` stays out of the published html-tier roster until a real element exists; this card is that element. ⛔ Not graded here. ## Fact - `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/html-elements.tsx` registers the html tier's sanitised element passthroughs (`TAGS`). Its header says `code` is "registered elsewhere". - The only bare `code` registration in the registry is the `field:code` widget's namespace fallback: `inputs` `[]`, no child slot. It is a code editor, or a `pre` of `value` when readonly. - The console's html-tier compile (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`) whitelists `ComponentRegistry.getKnownTypes()`. So `inline` on a `kind:'html'` page resolves to that widget, and the text `inline` is dropped. Measured by the objectui#10735 dev at base `5ad3b888`. - ADR-0081 §2 lists no `code` element either. **Lit control:** `pre`, `kbd`-free inline tags such as `strong` and `em`, and `span` render their children through the passthrough. ## Direction (for triage, not a ruling) Register `code` as a passthrough in `html-elements.tsx`'s `TAGS`, with the same sanitised shape as its siblings. That is one entry in an existing loop. Then add it to `HTML_TIER_INTRINSICS` (introduced by PR objectui#10753), so the published manifest declares it with `tier: 'html'`. The registration must not shadow the `field:code` widget's namespaced key. - Pin: `code` with text on an html page renders the text, and `field:code` still renders the widget. - Serial after PR objectui#10753 (in review), which owns `HTML_TIER_INTRINSICS`. ## Dedupe The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, matched against `field:code|html.{0,40}code (tag|element)|deprecationFor`: 0 hits. Dedupe words: `html tier code tag field:code fallback` · `html-elements.tsx code registered elsewhere drift` --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
